definition: The task of answering a natural language question about the content of a given image.
details: VQA requires a model to jointly reason over visual content and linguistic queries, making it a challenging benchmark for multimodal understanding capabilities.
story: Imagine an art restorer who can spot a single cracked tile in a vast mosaic. Think of it this way: The task of answering a natural language question about the content of a given image. And here is the clever part: VQA requires a model to jointly reason over visual content and linguistic queries, making it a challenging benchmark for multimodal understanding capabilities. The model looks the way you look at a crowd and finds the one face you know. And that is Visual Question Answering — giving a machine the gift of sight.
